steps.text: Yoshitsune brings Hofukaru, Orchid, and Masamune to the scene only to see Catapult kneeling by Midnight, lost in thought.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Mid...night?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, you're all here!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: He's not dead yet, but he ain't looking so good either!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We rushed over after hearing the Lord of Thunder's roar!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What happened?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I don't know either. All I saw by the time I made it here was the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder... did this to him?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I... Like I said, I don't know!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But... I saw it using your powers!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It was just like your purification ceremony back at the palace! It absorbed the black miasma into its own body!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: No... Impossible...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Really?! Are you sure you didn't meowstake it for something else?

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Affirmitive growl)

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Not only did it kill Mother... it even stole her miko powers...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I see, that explains everything. No wonder it could open the gates to summon the Hexhowls...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: So that's how it is. Heh, heheh... I see.
She kneels next to Midnight with her hand outstretched, lightly wiping blood off his face.
She does not cry, not even a single tear.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hofukaru...
The surrounding samurai are shaken by both their fallen shogun and the terrible news.

steps.name: Samurai A
steps.text: The shogun...

steps.name: Samurai B
steps.text: That Iju... to think it could steal the former lord's powers as well... it's over for us...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Another Iju?! Wasn't there supposed to be only one of these things per trial? Why's there another one?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Tch. What a mess.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Masamune, Hofukaru. Let's flank it as a distraction while we look for a weak point!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hofukaru?!

steps.name: Escorchgot
steps.text: (Angry howl)

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Leave.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult, we—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Stand back! I can handle it myself!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hofukaru...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Excellent...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: HOFUKARU!!!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: She's purr-fectly fine!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She's insane, you mean! Using the shockwave from the explosives to both cover herself and propel herself to the Escorchgot?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Is she... trying to purify it?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Don't be rash, Your Meowjesty! This will only take a massive toll on your body!
Hofukaru remains oblivious to her surroundings.
Her focus remains solely on pinning the Escorchgot down, remaining unyielding no matter how much the beast thrashes about.
Until its body slowly slumps to the ground.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hofukaru! Let us help you too!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...'Tis not enough.
She stands up without looking at anyone else. Walking directly towards the sinkhole's edge, her pace suggests she is ready to throw everything aside to fall into the abyss alone.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Just hold it!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This no longer concerns thee.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And what about your samurai, your country? They're all looking to you!
Hofukaru slowly turns back, her hollow gaze sending a chill down Orchid's spine.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What of it? All that matters to me is ending its life.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Your Majesty, please reconsider.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Midnight has fallen, so thou art taking his place to stand in my way?

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: It is because he has fallen that I must say this in his stead.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Hunting the Lord of Thunder is something that must be carefully planned—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Calm down, Hofukaru!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Lord of Thunder has harmed my nation, and even Midnight!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Yet still thou wouldst see me remain calm?!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: I have served the shogun for a long time. I, too, am terribly shaken by his defeat.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: But as we stand here, I remember his wisdom: hunting the Lord of Thunder is something that must be carefully planned!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Make way!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Everyone, stop!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Madam Orchid, please—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I see you've all inherited his stubbornness too.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Our first priority is to get him back to the city for treatment! He's not dead yet.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Second, a group must stay here, to make sure none of the beasts below try to climb back up!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No buts!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Understood. Do as Madam Orchid says!

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And you, Hofukaru.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't care what exactly's on your mind right now, but if you're going, I'm going too. We can't get home without slaying that beast.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I won't tell you to give up on vengeance. You wouldn't listen anyway. But you should know better than anyone here how strong the Lord of Thunder is.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So we'll hunt it together with you.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...As you wish.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Her eyes... She doesn't seem convinced. But there's no other way now.)

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Madam Orchid...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm not like your shogun. I never agreed to stop her.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Surely he told you why the Hunter's Association exists.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: It is to aid Her Majesty in hunting the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Well? Isn't this your perfect chance to do so?

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: You are... completely right.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Whisper) This is the best method we have right now, but I'll try to figure out a way to calm her down.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: ...We are counting on you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Get me a brush and some paper.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I want to write a letter, for Suponosuke to hand to the shogun once he wakes up.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Masamune, Catapult, Yoshitsune! Prepare ropes and lighting equipment!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's... prepare for the hunt.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Oh no, they've breached the gates! Quick, bring out the rolling logs and fire oils!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Their weak points are their eyes and their joints! All units, heed my orders! Concentrate your fire there!

steps.name: Beast Pack
steps.text: (Happy howling)
The samurai on the city walls loose their arrows in succession, but fail to deal much damage to the sea of rock-hard hides.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: No... they're too tough...
As if angered by the arrows, the beasts back away slightly before letting out a deafening cacophony of roars, then slam their bodies against the gates with even greater ferocity.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: We're finished!

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: We're nothing without the shogun and Her Majesty!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: No, it is too early to yield!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Her Majesty and the two Iju Hunters have already gone after the Lord of Thunder, so we must hold on until their mission is complete.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: But for how long?

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: For the shogun's sake, we must protect the capital!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: He kept this nation safe for ten long years, and now it is our turn to return the favor!

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: If you wish to run, then go ahead. I won't blame you.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: ...I'm sorry, Captain.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: A reasonable choice.

steps.name: Samurai Captain
steps.text: Hmph, come at me, beasts! Nothing but death awaits you here!
Midnight still remembers his last meeting with the former lord.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty, please reconsider.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The scouts bring unfortunate news: the Iju is stronger than any recorded in our history. We are ill-prepared to face it, and... we've already lost half the expedition squad.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Are you still unwilling to heed my counsel?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Do you... think me unaware of the condition you're in? Of the blood you coughed up that night in the courtyard, of that piercing black staining your hands?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The curse infected you long ago! Returning to battle is no different from throwing your life away!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But even if you disregard your own well-being, then I implore you to consider it for the nation, for Hofukaru! She is yet so young. She cannot lose her mother, just as Houei cannot lose you!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Am I to blame? Am I too weak? Is that why you must place yourself in mortal peril again and again? With but a single word, I would gladly sacrifice everything for your sake!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: So, please... I beg of you. Do not go.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Why... why do you insist?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Stop right there! I order you to stay put!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: No... I have no right to give you orders...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Please... don't go...
That was the last time he saw the former lord.
Our previous lord has left us.
Houei cannot afford to lose Her Majesty as well.
Lady Hofukaru possesses a brilliant mind, and with time she will no doubt mature into an exceptional ruler, just as the former lord once was.
But time... Yes, time is what we need most...
So to buy us more time, so that Her Majesty can grow up safely...
I am willing to bear her hatred, to take on all of her enmity that was meant for the Lord of Thunder.
This way is safer.
But...
Is it right?
